items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And she did most of Fletcher's, and she copied mine.

ctx.x: You never saw the score again, and, of course, the good part about that you didn't have to extract your score. They had the copies, naturally, and of course, Fletcher's wife was quite instrumental in that; she was an excellent
And she did most of Fletcher's, and she copied mine. Fletcher scored in concert, which is rough on a copyist.
Right, cause they had to transpose.
